 Lloyd co-founded the pioneering rock band alongside Tom Verlaine, Billy Ficca, and Richard Hell By Alex Suskind November 7, 2026 Michael Putland/Getty Images Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Richard Lloyd, the co-founding guitarist of Television, has died, The New York Times reports . The cause was cholangiocarcinoma, a bile duct cancer. He was 75.
 This story is developing.
